entity.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull: Red Skull, Keeper of the Soul Stone
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.1: So. Another seeker climbs my mountain. They always arrive believing they are the first.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.2: I keep the Soul Stone. I have waited here a very long time, and I have learned patience.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.3: The stone is no prize to be won. It answers only to a sacrifice.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.4: A soul for a soul. Bring something you love to the edge of the chasm, and let it fall.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.5: Do not look so grim. It will cost you only what you are willing to lose.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.6: Many have stood where you stand. Some turned back. A few did not return from the edge.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.7: There is no sun here. I stopped counting the dawns that never came.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.8: I have watched the stones change every hand that ever held them. Not one of those hands was worth the price.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.red_skull.9: Go on, then. The cliff is patient. So am I.

book.infinity_gauntlet.chronicle.title: The Chronicle of Victor von Doom
book.infinity_gauntlet.chronicle.p1:
I, Boris, served the house of von Doom before the boy could walk.

His father Werner was a healer of our Zefiro people. His mother Cynthia was a sorceress, and her bargain with a devil cost her soul.
book.infinity_gauntlet.chronicle.p2:
Victor swore to free her. He studied science and sorcery alike, and in America met Reed Richards, whom he never forgave.

A machine meant to reach the dead burst in his face.
book.infinity_gauntlet.chronicle.p3:
In the mountains of Tibet the monks forged him a mask. He put it on still hot from the fire.

He came home to Latveria, threw down the Baron who had hunted our people, and took the throne. Hassenstadt became Doomstadt.
book.infinity_gauntlet.chronicle.p4:
His robots walk our streets, his face is on every wall, and no Latverian goes hungry.

He says the world would be better ruled by Doom. Some nights, watching the storm from this window, I believe him. Some nights I fear it.

screen.infinity_gauntlet.latveria_welcom: These are the lands of Doctor Doom, and so here you must be extremely careful.

A walled city of townsfolk lies in the valley under the castle on the mountain. Nothing here can be broken: not by pickaxe, blast, beam or the Gauntlet's powers, and fire you light dies out by itself. The gate at the south end of the city takes you back home.

At night searchlights comb the slope and the city's streets. The eye at the top of the screen shows how close you are to being found: a beam, a Doombot that sees you, and noise (running, jumping, fighting, the Gauntlet's powers) fill it. Crouch, keep to the dark and break their line of sight.

When the alarm sounds, a squad of Interceptors flies out for you. They search where you were last seen, question the townsfolk and look into houses. A yellow "?" over a robot means it senses something, a red "!" that you are found. Give them nothing for two minutes and they fly home.
The road climbs to the castle gate, watched by a patrol and by the lamps. The gate is not the only way in: look closely at the castle's walls, and think about what keeps its lights burning.
Whoever reaches the throne room will face Doctor Doom. Come armed, come ready, and do not expect mercy.

Fifteen seconds. Doom's patience has limits.
Last warning. We are coming in.
The house is empty. The intruder slipped away. Widen the search.

npc.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.citizen.s: Loyal Subject of the New King
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.mechan: Quiet, stranger! Shut the door behind you... Doom's patrols listen to every whisper. I saw you slip into the city. You came to bring Victor down, didn't you? For thirty years I built his machines—and for thirty years I waited for someone bold enough to challenge him.
Can you help me get inside the castle?

Storming the front gates is madness. Right beneath the castle's throne room roars a massive primary generator. It powers every searchlight, force shield, and Doombot in the garrison. I built a Generator Disruptor: slip through the eastern service door into the under-castle vault and clamp this device onto the generator core. The entire castle will go dark, the Doombots will freeze, and the path to Doom's throne will stand wide open!
Give me the device. I'll shut down the generator.

Here—hold onto it tight. In the castle's east wing there is a green shaft of light: step over its edge and it lowers you into the generator vault. Attach the Disruptor to the generator column (Right-Click) and the defenses will collapse!
Still here? The main generator hums right beneath Castle Doom! Head through the eastern service door, descend into the under-castle vault, and use the Disruptor on the generator core.
I lost the Disruptor. Do you have a spare?

You did it! The tower lights went out and the castle garrison is completely powerless! Not a single Doombot at the gates will stand in your way now. March straight into the throne room and end Doom's tyranny!
Your Majesty! Doom has fallen, and his iron sentinels stand frozen as grey statues across the valley. Latveria finally breathes free beneath your crown!
Thank you for your service, Master Radovan.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.tavern: Psst, traveler... Step away from the window toward my cellar stairs. Dressed like that, you won't make it a single block—the Doombot patrols will sound the alarm on sight. Want to walk the streets of Doomstadt like one of us?

The finest ale in Latveria is brewing down in my cellar, but my grain stores ran dry under curfew. Bring me 8 sheaves of wheat for the mash, and I'll give you a genuine Latverian Citizen Cloak. Wearing it, Doombots and searchlights will take you for a local—just don't brush right up against a robot or start a brawl in front of them!
Here is 8 wheat. Hand over the cloak!
Check the storehouses or bring 8 wheat from the Overworld through the southern gate—just 8 wheat and the cloak is yours.
Fine wheat indeed! This batch of ale will be legendary. Wear the cloak over your shoulders: as long as you don't step right up to a Doombot or break the peace, no patrol will bother you.
Pour me another mug of Latverian ale!
I lost my citizen cloak. Do you have another?
Long live our new King! Tonight the entire cellar is open in your honor—the finest brew in Doomstadt for the liberator of Latveria!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.citize: We speak in whispers even indoors... They say Old Mechanic Radovan tinkers at night in the western workshop, and Mirko hides folks by the dark cellar stairs in the eastern tavern.
Keep your eyes off the searchlights and give the Doombots a wide berth. Without our citizen cloak, they'll raise the alarm in a heartbeat.
You can hear Doom's massive generator humming beneath the mountain. So long as it feeds the castle, his iron legions never tire.
Victor saved us from the barons, yet turned the whole nation into a fortress. Could anyone truly defeat Doom himself?
Old Mechanic Radovan waits in the workshop west of the square, and Tavernkeeper Mirko stands by the dark cellar entrance in the tavern to the east. Speak with them—they'll help you prepare.
Glory to our new King! The Doombots have frozen like stone statues, and the fire in their eyes is gone forever!
Your Majesty! The searchlights are out for good. We hail you as the rightful ruler of Latveria!
Long live the new sovereign of Doomstadt! May your reign bring peace to our valley!
Doom's iron guards stand with bowed heads like eternal statues. You have achieved the impossible, my King!

msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.stea: §2[Doctor Doom]§r Pathetic fool... The Infinity Gauntlet belongs to Doom alone!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r One stone short... Doom himself shall finish what you lacked the will to complete!
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.stol: §6Doom seized the Infinity Gauntlet and vanished through a spatial rift! Return to the Overworld and follow the compass.
Doom stole the Gauntlet! Return to the Overworld
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.aren: §2[Doctor Doom]§r Out of my way! You are not Doom's quarry this hour—HE has arrived!
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.than: §5[Thanos]§r You dare claim MY Gauntlet, mortal in an iron mask?! I will grind you to ash!
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.kill: §2[Doctor Doom]§r A 'Mad Titan'... Nothing more than a primitive warlord before the might of Doom!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r And your wretched warship shall turn to dust alongside you!
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.gaun: §2[Doctor Doom]§r The sun itself is mine now. Let it fall!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r The moon bows to the Gauntlet. Let it fall on you!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r Time is a river, and I turn it. Slow, little king.
§2[Doctor Doom]§r Reality is clay. Watch the ground forget itself!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r Your will is not your own. Rise.
§2[Doctor Doom]§r Give me your life. I have more use for it.
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.pull: §2[Doctor Doom]§r There is no sky above Doom's hall. Come down.
msg.infinity_gauntlet.latveria.doom.fina: §2[Doctor Doom]§r And now—you. Come for your Gauntlet with Stormbreaker in hand? Try and take it from Doom!
§2[Doctor Doom]§r Impossible... Even wielding the Infinity Stones... Doom... cannot fall...
§aThe Infinity Gauntlet flies back to your hand. Thanos and Doom are vanquished!
Infinity Gauntlet Reclaimed! Doom & Thanos Vanquished

dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.root: Quiet, traveler! Doom's patrols listen to every sound. You came to overthrow Victor, didn't you? I am ready to help you prepare to defeat him.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.who: For thirty years I built machines for that castle—and watched Victor turn our homeland into an iron cage. I know every gear of his fortress.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.plan: In the deep basement right beneath Castle Doom roars a huge generator. I built a Disruptor: take the light lift in the castle's east wing down to the basement and attach it to the core (Right-Click) to disable all defenses and Doombots!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.given: Hold onto the Disruptor! Step into the lift shaft in the castle's east wing, ride down to the basement and attach the device to the generator (Right-Click). Once the castle goes dark, walk straight into the throne room to fight Doom!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.sabota: The generator in the castle basement is stopped! Every searchlight is out and the castle Doombots are offline. The path is clear—march straight into the hall and fight Doom!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.king: Your Majesty! Doom is vanquished, and his iron legions stand frozen as grey statues forever. All of Latveria hails its new King!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.opt.wh: Who are you, and why oppose Doom?
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.mechanic.opt.pl: How can I disable the castle defenses?
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.root: Psst, traveler... Step closer to the dark entrance to my ale cellar. Dressed like that, the Doombot patrols will seize you on the first street.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.cellar: Down in the cellar beneath the tavern I brew the finest ale in Doomstadt, but patrols cut off my grain supply. Help me out with some wheat, and I'll make it worth your while.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.cloak_of: Bring me 8 wheat for my ale, and I'll give you a Latverian Citizen Cloak so patrols ignore you! Just don't step right up to a Doombot or start a fight in front of them, or they'll expose you.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.cloak_gi: Fine grain indeed! Here is your Latverian Citizen Cloak and two mugs of ale. Wear it, keep your distance from Doombots, and don't start fights!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.king: Long live our new King! Today my ale cellar stands wide open for the liberator of Latveria!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.opt.cell: What is down in that dark cellar?
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.tavern.opt.ask_: How can I walk past Doombot patrols?

dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.fear.1: We're afraid to even look out the window... Doombot patrols and searchlights watch every step.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.fear.2: In the basement right beneath the castle hums a huge generator powering all of Doom's robots. If only someone could shut it off...
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.hints: Old Mechanic Radovan sits in the western workshop—he can help power down the castle. And in the tavern by the dark cellar stairs, trader Mirko trades a Citizen Cloak for wheat.
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.king.1: Long live our new King! All Doombots and searchlights have shut down forever!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.king.2: Your Majesty! The Doombots have gone dark and stand as grey statues with bowed heads forever!
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.citizen.opt.hin: Who in the city can help defeat Doom?
dialog.infinity_gauntlet.opt.king_thanks: Thank you for your loyalty, free Latveria!
